opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits paid OneCoin participation by linking token packages, priced from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000, with projected appreciation and cash-out returns. It identifies a starter package costing 100 European euros and says that, if the price rises to 100 euros, there would be a cash-out. It further promises recurring weekly payments and describes token generation through mining, while presenting the opportunity as legally approved. Participation is also framed as an earning path through a corresponding team structure, making the appeal recruitment-linked rather than ordinary cryptocurrency education. The closing prompt to enter now presses for immediate participation, while the claims of high profitability and legal approval reinforce the invitation to buy into the opportunity.
